bookingAid.title: Booking.com Affiliate ID (aid)
bookingAid.description: Optional. Appended to Booking.com links as &aid= for commission tracking. Leave empty to deep-link without tracking (no account required).

affiliateTemplates.title: Affiliate link wrappers
affiliateTemplates.description: Optional per-provider affiliate deep-link wrappers. Key = provider id (e.g. "expedia"), value = a URL template containing the literal token {url}, which is replaced with the URL-encoded destination link. Lets you plug in a CJ / Impact / Partnerize / Awin wrapper without code changes. Leave empty for plain links.

liteApiKey.title: LiteAPI key (enables live prices)
liteApiKey.description: Optional. When set, lodging places show a live lowest nightly rate from LiteAPI (https://liteapi.travel) with editable currency + guest nationality. Leave empty to ship deep-link price comparison only (Tier 1). Use a sand_… key to test, prod_… to go live. Search/rate calls are free on LiteAPI's core tier; booking is not done in-app (deep-link hand-off only).

liteApiCurrency.title: LiteAPI default rate currency
liteApiCurrency.description: ISO-4217 currency used to preset the rate controls and request LiteAPI rates (e.g. EUR, USD). Users can change the currency per request in the panel. Only used when a LiteAPI key is set.

enableTypeaheadResolvers.title: Enable typeahead hotel-id resolvers
enableTypeaheadResolvers.description: When on (default), id-only OTAs may resolve an exact-hotel link via the OTA's own typeahead endpoint (currently Trip.com only) in addition to the always-on Wikidata source. Turn off to use only the clean Wikidata ids.
